text: The main statements of the draft with their status. Numbers refer to the version of the paper on this site. computer: checked by an exact computation (lattices modulo pE in Howell form, or the truncated Magnus algebra, with the exactness certificate); paper: proved; Lean: formally verified.

paper · Reduction: D5(G)⊆γ4(G) for all groups D5(Q)=1 for all finite 2-groups of class 3. For finite G the order does not grow: 2-groups up to the 2-part of |G| suffice. · Prop. 2.1, Rem. 2.3; first step in Lean
Lean · For Lie rings D5(L)⊆γ4(L) (Ionin, Mikhailov, Petrov, 2026); the formalization audited, the group question stated in Lean next to it. · §3, §4
computer + paper · D5(G)⊆γ4(G) for every finite G with Sylow 2-subgroup of order ≤210, in particular for all groups of order <2048. · Thm. 5.4(1)
computer + paper · Order 211, class 3: D5=1 for ranks 2, 3, 4 and ≥8; ranks 5–7 open. · Prop. 5.7, §5
computer · Dn(G)=γn(G) for all n and every finite group of order <512. · Thm. 5.4(2)
computer + paper · No 3-torsion in D5(G)/γ5(G) when the Sylow 3-subgroup of G has order ≤39; D5=γ5 for all 3-groups of order ≤39. · Thm. 6.11
paper · D5(G)=γ5(G) whenever G/γ2(G) is finite of exponent 3, of any rank and order. · Thm. 6.6
paper · p odd, |γ3/γ4|=p, γ2/γ3 with at most two generators [γ2,γ2]⊆γ5. Hence a non-metabelian p-group of class 4 and rank d has order ≥ pd+5. · Lemma 6.3, Prop. 6.5
paper · p odd, P of class 3 with |γ2/γ3|=p2, |γ3|=p the p-covering group has P*=1: all step-1 descendants are metabelian. · Thm. 6.9
computer · Class-3 quotients of Rips-type groups of orders 240–2107: D5=1 in all, D4≠1 in three of them (with the exactness certificate). · §7, question 1
computer · The group analogue of Theorem C at c=4: the plateau group has D6≠1 but D7=1, so 2c-2 is attained and the analogue, if true, is sharp. · §7, question 3
